basis: Gross presidential salary accrued at the statutory $400,000 a year (3 U.S.C. 102), pro rata for 665 days; the rate is set by law and the arithmetic is ours.
notes: This is the salary due by law, not money shown to have been kept. Row C95-02 is a part of this same money that was given away: do not add the two rows; subtract C95-02 from this row. Excludes the $50,000-a-year non-taxable expense allowance (unused amounts revert to the Treasury under the statute) and the $100,000-a-year travel allowance, which are for official use; whether the expense allowance is drawn is not public. Trump says he donates the whole salary.

basis: The White House Historical Association, a private nonprofit, said on October 27, 2025 that the president had given $66,000 of his salary to its work since January; this includes the 'first paycheck' Trump announced on August 6, 2025.
notes: The only documented second-term donation. It comes from the recipient's own statement, read in full in November 2026; the same statement calls a reported $50 million contribution from the president untrue. No quarter-by-quarter breakdown is given. It is about two months of gross pay against about $306,800 accrued by October 27, 2025. Do not count the August 2025 'first paycheck' announcement separately: it is included here. No donation is documented for Q4 2025 or Q1-Q3 2026 (rechecked to mid-November 2026), and no rows are recorded for those quarters. The gift may be tax-deductible to Trump as a charitable contribution; no second-term return is public.
